blocks.text: Carbon-carbon double bond par hydrogen jur kar alkane banna organic reduction reaction ki misal hai.

Organic synthesis mein different reducing agents istemal hote hain, maslan LiAlH₄, NaBH₄, Sn + concentrated HCl. Nitriles se amines, amides se amines, carboxylic acid se primary alcohols aur nitrobenzene se phenylamine banana, yeh sab reduction ki misalein hain aur class 12 mein parhi jayengi.

blocks.prompt: C₄H₈ ka position isomerism dikhane wala isomer batayein, ethoxy methane aur propanol kis qisam ke isomers hain, aur alkenes mein kaun si structural isomerism mumkin hai (Quick Check 11.9a se c)?
blocks.explanation: But-1-ene CH₂=CHCH₂CH₃ aur but-2-ene CH₃CH=CHCH₃, C₄H₈ ke position isomers hain. Ethoxy methane CH₃CH₂OCH₃ aur propan-1-ol CH₃CH₂CH₂OH dono C₃H₈O hain magar functional groups alag (ether aur alcohol): functional group isomers. Alkenes mein chain isomerism (but-1-ene aur 2-methylpropene), position isomerism (but-1-ene aur but-2-ene) aur cycloalkanes ke saath functional group isomerism (but-1-ene aur cyclobutane) ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: d) C₄H₉NH₂ ke different isomers likhein (Quick Check 11.9d).
blocks.explanation: C₄H₉NH₂ (yani C₄H₁₁N) ke chaar primary amine isomers hain, jin mein –NH₂ carbon chain par alag jagah hai ya chain branched hai: butan-1-amine CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂, butan-2-amine CH₃CH₂CH(NH₂)CH₃, 2-methylpropan-1-amine (CH₃)₂CHCH₂NH₂ aur 2-methylpropan-2-amine (CH₃)₃CNH₂. Pehle do position isomers hain aur baqi chain isomers. Isi formula ke secondary aur tertiary amines bhi hain (maslan CH₃CH₂NHCH₂CH₃ aur CH₃CH₂N(CH₃)₂), lekin –NH₂ wale yahi chaar hain.

blocks.prompt: In mein organic redox reactions pehchanein: oils ki margarine mein hydrogenation, bromine water se unsaturation ka test, aur methane ka jalna.
blocks.explanation: Hydrogenation mein C=C par hydrogen jurti hai: reduction. Methane ke jalne mein oxygen jurti hai (CO₂ aur H₂O bante hain): oxidation. Bromine ka addition is organic maane mein na oxygen jorta hai na hydrogen hatata hai; yeh electrophilic addition hai.

items: Oxidation: combustion (C₂H₆ → CO₂ + H₂O), ozonolysis, epoxidation, acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se primary alcohol → acid.
Reduction: alkene + H₂ (Pt) → alkane; ethanal + 2[H] (LiAlH₄) → ethanol; reducing agents LiAlH₄, NaBH₄, Sn/conc. HCl.
